_note: Cell shape by height × radius (CellShape.cs, 00_07 HW.33) — a probe, never a verification: no golden, no OK/FAILED. stretch_* = the cell's principal stretches relative to the shell's constant-period nominal, ASCENDING (index 0 = the most compressed axis); predicted = the first-order phase map (CellShape.GradedJacobian). Chords are stereological mean chords along an axis, NOT µCT local thickness — compare them to the nominal chord of the same shell, never to a print floor. sub_floor_solid_fraction = the share of the cell's intended metal that the opening at print_floor_mm deletes — CheckPrintFidelity's model and ceilings, binned by cell: intended metal below the floor, never a statement of what the machine does with it. The CORE shell (shell 0) is reported but excluded from the headline gap — the phase is a cone about the axis, so no local fabric exists there (probe_capped_at_axis marks where the probe was shortened). specific_surface_* = S_V from the same probe lines (2·⟨P_L⟩), the quantity verify's golden `specific_surface_mm2_per_mm3` carries.
